Maraines in moral extends fairy godmothers to social patrons; baptism-only definition needs contextual patronage review.
La identity includes definite article and direct-object pronoun occurrences under the meaning the. Separate article/pronoun assignments before approving one quiz set.
Ayant is present participle avoir, with lexical and auxiliary uses; sense incorrectly defines avait imperfect third singular. Correct shared metadata and usages.
Tout includes determiner, pronoun and intensifying adverb (tout frais, tout entier, tout à coup) under determiner every/all. Audit occurrence-level grammatical roles.
L’ combines elided definite article and direct-object pronoun under article the; requires separation.
Été is être past participle, but shared sense says are and conflates copula/auxiliary uses. Correct metadata and roles before approving.
Se is unelided reflexive/pronominal marker, but definition incorrectly specifies elided form. Correct metadata and distinguish reflexive/reciprocal/inherent-pronominal uses as needed.
Trouva includes se trouver in a state, discovering mice, and judging someone beautiful; current find-searched-object definition covers only one. Explicit sense separation.

Fut includes copular and auxiliary simple past, with historical unaccented imperfect-subjunctive use possible in croyoit pas qui fut onze heures; shared definition are is incorrect. Review form and senses.
Lui includes indirect object to him/her and stressed pronoun with lui/vers lui. Definition to him fails feminine and stressed uses. Correct metadata and explicit mappings.
Prêter in sources means lend with expected return; imported fournir, donner definition obscures loan vs gift. Correct lending sense.
Subsister refers to supporting life with food; definition only continued existence of things explicitly excludes animate subject. Correct live-on/survive sense.

Dit combines present, simple past, past participle, and expressive dire uses under says. Surface may legitimately share lemma sense but inflected metadata must represent tense ambiguity; review exact role before approval.
Est shared sense says are and conflates copula/auxiliary roles. Correct invariant lemma sense instead of incorrect tense translation.
Que includes interrogative what and optative subjunctive que Votre Majesté..., while definition describes one specific rhetorical question. Separate grammatical uses.
Que faisiez-vous asks what activity, not specifically creating/manufacturing material objects. Correct generic do sense.
Déplaise in ne vous déplaise is a polite concessive/optative formula, and imported definition restricts subject to persons. Correct dislike/displease event sense and expression coverage.

En preposition sense contains pronominal en (j’en suis aise, en veut, en donne) and gerund marker occurrences. Reassign appropriate pronoun usages to existing pronoun en and review grammatical marker.
Suis is être first singular present, but sense are incorrect. Correct shared metadata before reauthoring templates.
Bien includes emphatic indeed, degree very, manner well and Eh bien connective; narrow emphasis definition does not cover all. Separate source uses.
Ce includes demonstrative determiner and independent demonstrative pronoun in ce n’est/ce qui/ce que. Split grammatical identities or explicitly broaden with role-safe quizzes.
Du mixes contraction de+le, partitive du secours, and proper-name particle du Paty. Correct occurrence roles before approval.
Que exclamation sense contains interrogative/relative/complement/comparison/restrictive constructions. Extensive occurrence reassignment needed; do not approve under one exclamation meaning.
Êtes copular and auxiliary forms use shared être sense are; coordinate consistent lemma metadata/role correction with other être forms rather than approving one while others remain false.
Me includes indirect, direct and reflexive usages under to me. Define accurate roles and separate where necessary.
Si combines conditional if, intensifier so, indirect whether and affirmative si. Separate occurrences before approval.
Le includes definite article, direct object pronoun and nominalization under the. Separate pronoun assignments and audit relevant uses.
Des contraction sense contains indefinite plural article des bracelets/des billets/des mouches and others. Separate indefinite uses to correct identity.
Ces definition says this rather than plural these/those; correct metadata and generic demonstrative lemma sense.
Il includes referential he/it and impersonal il faut/il y a/il s’agit. Define impersonal role explicitly rather than solely he.
S’ reflexive marker sense incorrectly includes elided si in s’ils/s’il. Explicitly reassign conditional occurrences and review pronominal constructions.
